notes: Awardee University of New Mexico; PI Tyson L Swetnam; start 07/15/2026, end 05/31/2029; $4,617,408.
Program element is 'Artificial Intelligence (AI)' (296Y00); the record names no IDSS program. MESA site footer says Integrated Data Systems & Services (developer-reported); see slide 20.

quote: The goal of project MESA (Multidisciplinary Environment for Scientific Advancement) is to build a shared, open-source platform in which scientific data from many fields are automatically described, organized, and connected

value: Infrastructure is planned in the award
quote: MESA will operate on public NSF cyberinfrastructure accessed through ACCESS-CI (Texas Advanced Computing Center, Open Storage Network, CyVerse, and Jetstream-2 Cloud) and the integrated Rule-Oriented Data System (iRODS)
notes: Future tense: the award describes this as planned, for a two-year prototype starting July 2026.

value: Developer describes MESA as open source and running today
quote: is an open-source, agentic AI platform that connects scientific data through curated, indexed metadata. A data lakehouse, a federated data mesh, and AI agents that speak both, running on national research infrastructure today.
notes: Developer-reported. The notes wording matches this sentence almost verbatim.

quote: Sign in to mesa.cyverse.org with a free CyVerse account to browse

quote: MESA is not a promise — the MCP stack is public and installs now.
